documents.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
documents.lead: President Trump announced the United States will get diesel from Russia after a phone call with President Putin. The Treasury Department issued a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market.

documents.title: Trump eases Russia sanctions to lure Putin toward Ukraine peace deal
documents.lead: The Treasury Department issued a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market, running through April 7, 2027. The deal is valued at 7 billion dollars.

documents.title: Putin Cons Trump Into Making Massive Oil Deal With Russia
documents.lead: The deal announced by President Trump eases sanctions on Russian diesel after a phone call with President Putin.
